messages:
emily: Hey team — customer seeing intermittent validation errors for function-calling structured output. Error: 'ValidationError: missing required property \"items\"' for some responses. Happened ~5x in last hour. Request ids: 01ABCDXYZ, 01ABCDXY2, 01ABCDXW9. Model: redwood-v2-large. Can we collect repro steps?

raj: Can you paste one full request id + the raw curl you used and the response body (or the truncated snippet)? Also confirm if they use streaming by default. Pinging @kai for schema angle.

emily: Sure — using curl to reproduce, note header x-request-id below. Response included schema error.
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/completions \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"x-request-id: 01ABCDXYZ\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\n    "model":"redwood-v2-large",\n    "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Return items as JSON array"}],\n    "functions": [{\n      "name":"list_items",\n      "parameters": {\n        "type":"object",\n        "properties": {\n          "items": {\n            "type":"array",\n            "items": {\n              "type":"object",\n              "properties": {\n                "id": {"type":"string"},\n                "name": {"type":"string"}\n              },\n              "required": ["id","name"]\n            }\n          }\n        },\n        "required": ["items"]\n      }\n    }],\n    "function_call":"auto"\n  }'\n```
Response (truncated): `{"error":"ValidationError: missing required property items"}`

kai: First thought: this looks like the tool returned a stringified JSON or the runtime delivered a chunked response that dropped brackets. Did they enable stream=true anywhere? If the function's result is a string rather than native JSON, schema validation will fail.

emily: Customer uses hosted SDK which streams by default for generation endpoints. In my curl I didn't set stream param, but their production setup often uses streaming. They report sometimes getting a complete function_call.arguments with parsed array, sometimes function_call.arguments is a string missing items.

raj: Please collect a debug bundle for 01ABCDXYZ and upload backend pod logs from the same timeframe. Run: `support collect-debug --req 01ABCDXYZ` and paste the bundle id here. Also include the exact tool response if available.

emily: Collected and uploaded — bundle id: 8a7f9c-debug-176543. ops-bot: Debug bundle 8a7f9c-debug-176543 uploaded (expires in 7 days).

sre_oncall: Heads up — there was a rolling deploy around 1765432000. Could be transient mix of runtimes. Checking request routing/ingress now. Any 5xx/latency spikes?

raj: Also need the raw tool response (what the user tool returned). If the external tool returns a JSON string in one field (e.g., `{\"output\":\"[{...}]\"}`) we'll pass that through as a string. That will fail validation if we expect an array.

emily: Customer confirmed their tool returns a stringified payload. Sample tool result they sent: `{"output":"[{\"id\":\"1\",\"name\":\"foo\"}]"}` — they expected the runtime to parse that into items array.

kai: That explains it. If the tool returns a string we don't auto-parse into JSON for function arguments. Streaming/chunking could make this intermittent if chunks split JSON quotes. Repro plan: mock a tool that returns stringified JSON and test with stream=true vs false.

emily: I ran a quick local repro with a mocked tool and saw the same intermittent validation failures when chunked across SSE events. When stream=false results are stable.

raj: Short-term workaround: ask customer to have their tool return structured JSON (not string), or set non-streaming on their fetch. We'll also add a helper to attempt JSON.parse on function outputs when schema expects non-string (opt-in). For triage: create an engineering ticket and link debug bundle. @kai can you open INF-3219?

kai: Creating INF-3219 — title: "attempt safe-JSON-coerce for function outputs when schema expects object/array (opt-in)". Linking bundle 8a7f9c-debug-176543.

emily: Customer is OK with workaround for now, wants ETA on a fix. Two asks from them: (1) confirm there were no auth/billing issues for these requests, (2) get a minimal curl repro they can run.

sre_oncall: No auth or billing anomalies for those request ids. There was a small 5xx spike during the deploy window only. Marking as monitored.

raj: I'll draft a minimal repro script that mocks the tool returning a stringified JSON and show how stream=true can split chunks. Emily — I'll drop the script here in an hour.

emily: Great—thanks all. I'll send the customer the workaround + repro when you post it, Raj. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: INF-3219 created by kai, priority P2, linked bundles: [8a7f9c-debug-176543].
